snippet.title: Formula Legends: Raw Power Pack | Trailer [GOG]
snippet.description:
GOG Preservation Program! 
https://www.youtube.com/@gogclassicsvault
Follow us on:
Web: 👉  https://bit.ly/3rpVmMh
Twitch: 👉  https://bit.ly/3vVI6CJ
Twitter: 👉  https://bit.ly/3fdOUFK
Facebook: 👉  https://bit.ly/2NWKVCw

Step back into racing history with the Raw Power Car Pack for Formula Legends! This DLC adds three incredible new cars to your garage, each inspired by iconic eras of motorsport:

Jorsey – A sleek, early-90s contender known for its elegant lines and breakthrough design.

Superbows – A daring late-70s experiment that pushed the limits of engineering with its radical, ground-hugging style.

Beta Borneo – A modern challenger from the 2020s, blending sharp aerodynamics with cutting-edge performance.
